notes.title: Fireside Feelings is part of Games Against Living Miserably 2025.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058370/bedc96453770aa1b04bc74d45d0b20d581cac625.jpg[/img]
[h2]To mark World Suicide Prevention Day, Fireside Feelings is proud to take part in Games Against Living Miserably 2025.[/h2]

Games are great. We all know that. But did you know they can also be great for your head?

Running from [b]September 8th to 15th[/b], we are taking part in Games Against Living Miserably 2025 - the event on Steam that celebrates how games can help us unwind, connect, and escape.

[previewyoutube=buDprkaYtog;full][/previewyoutube]

It’s presented by [b]Curve Games[/b] and the suicide prevention charity, [b]Campaign Against Living Miserably[/b].
By taking part, [b]we’ve pledged a donation to CALM’s life-saving work[/b].

[h3]Why your support matters[/h3]
[list][*] 1 in 4 of us will have suicidal thoughts.
[*] 125 people die by suicide every week.
[*] Someone attempts suicide every 3 minutes.
[*] Suicide is the biggest killer of men under 50. 
[*] Suicide is the leading cause of death for people aged 15-39.[/list]

So, grab a game (or two) and play your part against suicide.
https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/curvedigital/sale/GALM25

[h3]But that's not all-[/h3]
We will have a [b]new conversation pack[/b], dropping in a few days.
The topics:
[list][*] Fears and Hopes
[*] Sweetness
[*] Neither Yes, Nor No[/list]

notes.title: Conversation Pack 01 : Lost Messages
notes.content:
[p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058370/1c5084afbe1dbad03968acd9c159a148ae577230.png"][/img][/p][h3]Conversation Pack 1 is live: [/h3][p]3 new conversation topics added :
 • Anger[/p][p] • Tell Me a Story #1[/p][p] • The Lost Messages[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058370/6748b23c4a5d1487a2d92e0220b89a9e2ed7204c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Updates:[/h2][p]The sexual violence trigger warning icon has been updated
You can now move the camera using the keyboard by pressing the up and down arrow keys
Game accessibility has been improved by reducing the need to switch between keyboard and mouse during conversations. You can now:
Press Space to skip to the next dialogue bubble
Press Ctrl + Enter to send the final message, then Space or Enter to confirm or cancel
The NPC in the first conversation is no longer always the fox
A new button has been added to return to the background selection screen when launching a saved conversation
Improved detection to reduce false positives during moderation
Various spelling corrections
[/p][h2]Fixes:[/h2][p]Fixed a crash that could occur when running moderation mode with certain localizations or topics
Fixed a crash that could occur when playing the "Solitude" topic

notes.title: Fireside Feelings - Devlog #01
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058370/b28cf35ec25e17bf80cd5d67bd0ec6651271d4bb.png[/img]
[h3]It has been TWO WEEKS since the game has launched![/h3]
Over 2,000 players gathered around the campfire, and our Steam reviews are 100% positive—with more than 100 reviews so far. Needless to say, we’re absolutely thrilled by the warm and heartfelt welcome you’ve given Fireside Feelings.

It’s been so moving to see your kind, gentle, and empathetic responses. We’re doing our best to incorporate the most thoughtful, tender, and caring ones directly into the game—in all six of its supported languages: French, English, Spanish, Italian, German, and Brazilian Portuguese.

[h3]So far, we’ve moderated and added over 250 new conversations into the game, and we’re continuing to do so every single day![/h3]

At the same time, we’re hard at work on what’s coming next—and we’ll be sharing our Roadmap with you soon! (Tiny spoiler, but don’t tell anyone: 3 brand new conversation topics have already been sent off to our translation team 😉)

We honestly couldn’t be happier with the reception the game has received, both on Steam and on our Discord server. Watching the game and its community grow is an incredible experience, and we’re feeling full of excitement and motivation for what’s to come. ✨

Come hang out and chat with us on [url=https://discord.gg/jBM4TC58Af]Discord[/url]—we’d love to hear from you!
See you soon,

[i]- Team Empreintes[/i]💛

notes.title: Fireside Feelings x Kind Words
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058370/081456ff617d53be776506e2e605aafa1f353a60.png[/img]
[h2]Ella the deer added as a plushie to Team Empreintes’ new title, as Spark the campfire becomes a sticker to adorn Kind Words letters.[/h2]

Team Empreintes’ comfy, conversational experience Fireside Feelings, which was released during this weekend’s Wholesome Direct, has teamed up for a Steam bundle with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/popcannibal]Popcannibal[/url]’s low-fi, letter-writing experience, Kind Words.
[b]Players who own one of the two titles will receive a 10% discount when completing the set. The Cozy Conversations bundle runs for a limited time.[/b]

To celebrate the launch of the bundle, both games will pay tribute to the other, with Ella the deer added to Fireside Feelings as a customisable campfire plushie, while Spark the campfire becomes a new sticker to illustrate letters with in Kind Words.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058370/e7aff84a871c4a5926fd8648104a48840e151fe7.png[/img]
[h3][b]About Fireside Feelings[/b][/h3]
Share your thoughts and discover those shared by others, in Fireside Feelings. Gather around the welcoming warmth of the campfire and take part in conversations between people separated in space and time. Sometimes, we all need a good talk under the stars.

[h3][b]About Kind Words (lo fi chill beats to write to)[/b][/h3]
A game about writing nice letters to real people. Write and receive encouraging letters in a cozy room. Trade stickers and listen to chill music. We're all in this together. Sometimes all you need are a few kind words.
